title: Pointing-VLA: Typed Spatial Grounding Interfaces for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23138v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often expose spatial grounding through autoregressive text coordinates or opaque action tokens, creating brittle interfaces between multimodal reasoning and robot execution. We present Pointing-VLA, a typed hidden-state spatial readout built on Embodied-R1. Geometry-specific heads predict normalized points, object-functional grounding (OFG) heatmaps, and visual trajectories without serializing geometry as text. For the evaluated Bridge/WidowX and physical pick-place deployments, an explicit execution contract assigns PICK to source-conditioned OFG and PLACE to Pointing, providing direct stage-aligned spatial targets. Pointing-VLA achieves SOTA performance on Bridge/WidowX, averaging 72.9\% across the evaluated four-task set without Bridge-specific finetuning under collision-enabled CuRobo execution. translated_title: Pointing-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作操控的带类型空间接地接口
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常通过自回归文本坐标或不透明的动作令牌来暴露空间接地，这在多模态推理与机器人执行之间造成了脆弱的接口。我们提出了Pointing-VLA，一种基于Embodied-R1构建的带类型隐藏状态空间读出方法。几何专用头预测归一化点、对象功能接地（OFG）热图以及视觉轨迹，而无需将几何序列化为文本。在评估的Bridge/WidowX和物理拾放部署中，一个明确的执行契约将PICK分配给源条件OFG，将PLACE分配给Pointing，从而提供直接阶段对齐的空间目标。Pointing-VLA在Bridge/WidowX上达到了最先进的性能，在启用碰撞的CuRobo执行下，无需Bridge特定微调，在评估的四任务集上平均得分72.9%。Pointing和OFG在原生和跨数据集评估中显示出互补的优势。OFG/con（此处可能截断）
tldr: 本文提出Pointing-VLA，通过带类型的隐藏状态空间读出（结合对象功能接地热图和点预测）替代文本坐标，在机器人操控中实现了更稳健的阶段对齐空间目标，并在Bridge/WidowX上达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Pointing-VLA, which replaces text coordinates with typed hidden-state spatial readouts (combining object-functional grounding heatmaps and point prediction) for more robust stage-aligned spatial targets in robot manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Bridge/WidowX.
